reviews.text: A pleasant location, friendly and attentive staff. All this for an original "Parisian" tasting experience.

We brought in our cat, who was rubbing herself and meowing strangely. They gave her a painkiller, even though she was actually in heat like a young cat. €105 for making a mistake. They also tried to convince us to feed her canned food, because otherwise she would develop heart disease due to a lack of taurine.

So-so experience... it says 24 hours a day, but it closes at 10:30 PM; it says "emergency room," but when we went in, no one came to ask what had happened (even though there was no one there). After a long wait, we had to stop a doctor, who told us to wait for another one because he was only the oncologist for appointments. It closed in August, when clinics have become essential since the dawn of time, with vets' holidays. Well... there wasn't much assistance after the pet's discharge, when we would have needed a little more support for home treatments (one doctor even told us on the phone he couldn't help us because he hadn't handled our case himself). Overall, I got the impression of superficiality in the way they handled their clients, despite the certainly not affordable prices (in the end, it all cost us over €700).
The young nurses are very kind (well done!), the facility appears spacious and fairly well-maintained, but the doctors, on the other hand, are always too evasive and lacking in empathy.
In fairness, I would like to point out that the treatments and therapies were effective and the animal is now well.
Kind and helpful
Excellent service, professionalism and kindness.

I've been coming to this clinic for about a year because of a cat with squamous cell carcinoma on the eyelids of his right eye. Dr. Spugnini is treating him, and thanks to bleomycin and electrochemotherapy, the cat is still alive and well. Unfortunately, the location of the carcinoma doesn't allow for a complete recovery, but at least he can live, and the tumor isn't spreading. I'm satisfied with the doctor's impeccable work, but I can't say the same about the staff's courtesy. They often respond in an annoyed manner and aren't at all helpful.
Excellent clinic

Never again...I strongly advise against this clinic if you have serious problems...a very sad experience...WE CAN'T DO ANYTHING...WE CLOSE AT 10:30 PM!!!! Repeated like a secretary....done Ecofast....it's very serious, take him away!! It's 50 euros! SHAME!!!! Not even if they were a supermarket would they have acted with such coldness and total lack of empathy!!!
Very professional, kind and helpful staff

Welcoming atmosphere, friendly staff, Dr. Valentini, who treats my little girl and is part of the medical staff at the facility, is a professional with a humanity and professionalism unmatched. The examination rooms are clean and tidy...in short, for me, who seeks "perfection" when it comes to my furry little girl...10+
Thank you
The visit was a great success, excellent advice.

Thank you...you were professional and efficient without compromising on courtesy, empathy, and sensitivity. Your work and the way you welcomed us made all the difference. I recommend your clinic to everyone, and it will certainly become our safe haven, even for routine checkups for my two "canette corso." Thank you all. Alessandra and Artemide
Professionals
Professionalism and kindness from all the staff, absolutely recommended

A surreal experience. We took one of our dogs (16 months old) because he had aspirated something through his nose.
He underwent a pre-anesthesia cardiology checkup, and the result was "serious heart problem, inoperable because the risk of death would be too high."

The next day (heartfelt thanks to whoever solved the problem for us that same evening) we took him to another clinic for a cardiology checkup, already knowing we would soon lose him.

The cardiology checkup result: perfect dog, perfect heart. He was asleep, the grass awn was removed from his nose, and he was back to full health after 2 hours.

What can I say?...100% satisfied.
They were friendly and kind, and the dog became theirs.
Thanks to all of you.
From me too.
Veterinary clinic with very competent staff, you were really good in saving my Popicec, thank you so much also from Popicec.

I've been to this clinic four times.
Two of them in the last few weeks. After 10 days of antibiotics and anti-inflammatories, I hadn't even bothered to go to the vet or get a checkup before the dog started feeling sick again. The result: the wrong antibiotic, they gave me a new one, but I don't know if it's any good either. €300 for the two visits and another €200 for the medications.

I recommend this clinic only for very basic routine checkups and vaccinations or microchip implants.
I wholeheartedly advise against this clinic for anyone needing surgery for more serious issues.
I'm truly heartbroken, I can barely write this. If you care about your dogs/cats, etc., I advise you NOT to have them admitted to this clinic if necessary. Otherwise, you'll be left feeling guilty for life...
Get advice. Rome is a big city, and there are plenty of veterinarians capable of handling the job.

Unfortunately, I have to say that my experience at the facility, specifically seeing a specialist who works with them, was absolutely negative. My American bulldog, after being given chemotherapy at this clinic, left us this Saturday due to very serious kidney and liver poisoning!

Well done vet! Our border collie had dislocated her leg while playing because she bumped into the corner of the wall. They examined her immediately, took three X-rays, ruled out any fractures, prescribed an anti-inflammatory and gastroprotective medication, and gave her seven days of complete rest. After seven days, she was sprightly and running like before!
You guys are amazing!! Thank you for solving my cat's problems. A spotlessly clean place with plenty of space, and above all, extremely empathetic and knowledgeable staff. Thank you so much again!
Kind, knowledgeable and very empathetic with animals, honest prices, I recommend them
Optimal
It's a shame about the spaghetti with clams, which wasn't tasty at all. The pizza was very good, as were the zucchini flowers.
The clinic is located in a quiet area of ​​Rome with easy parking. The staff is very friendly, and Dr. Settimi is very knowledgeable.
Professional and kind. Highly recommended.
Professional, but too expensive
Excellent experience with both the dog and the cat. The staff is knowledgeable, attentive, and kind. I highly recommend it.

On Sunday afternoon, I went to the clinic urgently because my dog ​​was suffering from severe pain in his paw. I was truly satisfied and grateful for the excellent treatment I received: the staff was prompt, attentive, and very thorough.
Thank you again!!
Clean and welcoming, the medical staff is efficient and kind to the public and animals!! Highly recommended!

On Wednesday evening, I called the Casal Monastero clinic because my dog ​​was very ill. Unfortunately, I made the mistake of not checking their opening hours first: it was 10:10 PM, and they close at 10:30 PM. The person who answered the phone was immediately extremely rude and arrogant, repeatedly insisting that they were closing time. When I explained that I was calling on the instructions of another vet, she asked me in a confrontational tone what time I had been told to come. When I answered—around 9:30 PM—she replied that I could bring the dog earlier, and finally dismissed me by saying that I could bring the dog the following morning.

Of course, she couldn't have known that I also have a cat at home and that the dog was vomiting everywhere, forcing me to manage an already very complicated situation. That same evening, I took the dog to another clinic, where he was immediately admitted for dehydration.

I fully understand that it was almost closing time, and I wouldn't have insisted if I'd known, but in delicate moments like this, a little empathy, politeness, and tact would really make a difference.

Kind, attentive, and helpful, both with me and my dachshund.
The environment is quiet and well-kept. I'm very satisfied.
I recommend this facility.
Kind, understanding, and professional. Excellent.

I'm sorry I can't give a zero, and should be avoided at all costs. The staff were incompetent. A very negative experience. Be careful who you hand your furry friends to; unfortunately, they can't speak.
Friendly and helpful staff, prices a little high.
Excellent visit to the dog and excellent solution to the problems encountered. The vet was very helpful in explaining the problems and possible causes.

Professional and kind.
Highly recommended!
Professionalism and pure love for animals. Well done ❤️
Very kind and professional staff,

I happened upon this clinic by chance after an unfortunate incident involving a foxtail in my German Shepherd's nose. They were excellent and professional, both with pets and humans, and most importantly, I was contacted by the doctor who examined him for additional information. This is rare at a clinic where you're always looked after by a different person on duty. Congratulations and thank you.

We stopped by for an emergency, and the first thing that struck us was how empty it was. We quickly realized this when they sent us for a useless CT scan at another clinic (also notorious for its unethical behavior, as we later learned), hoping to clumsily convince us that the cat needed surgery. Luckily, I asked for a second opinion (which really annoyed them), which confirmed the futility of the proposed procedure and that it would certainly kill the cat. Convenient for vaccinations and routine tests because it's always empty, but for everything else, ALWAYS ask for a second opinion.
professionalism and kindness thank you for everything
Very kind and professional.
I took my cat for a few checkups and was very satisfied. So far, I can say that the prices are competitive and the level of professionalism is excellent.

...I called them for information and a reservation, and they only told me to call back on Monday, as today is Saturday. Buh
The tone was impatient and unpleasant.
A little strange for calls, but when I went in person for various visits or other things, they were very kind and professional.
In terms of professionalism and reliability, I'd say everything was excellent!
As for the call center, I'd say it needs improvement.
Excellent 🔝 …

Good clinic, only used once so far.

I've never set foot in this establishment. I called a little while ago for some information. The call lasted about 6 seconds, maybe less. The person on the other end was annoyed and irritated, almost as if I needed to apologize for calling and disturbing them. If this is their calling card, I'll go another mile, but I'll go elsewhere.
Kiwi thanks you, you are wonderful, thank you again for your professionalism, sensitivity, responsibility and kindness ❣️

The doctors who examined my lame cat were very kind, gave me many answers, and clarified any doubts I had.
I recommend this clinic to everyone!

Efficient, clean, and very well-organized clinic. The staff is highly competent. I want to thank all the vets who treated my cat, especially Dr. Settimi, who masterfully performed jaw surgery on my cat, literally bringing her back to life. Thank you!
The staff were helpful and friendly, as well as extremely competent.
They are always ready to assist you on any occasion
